recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的顆粒（particle）幾乎全由脂肪空泡、梭形基質細胞與纖維狀網架組成，缺乏密集的造血細胞群，呈現低細胞性、以基質為主的骨髓，符合移植後植入失敗（graft failure）的表現。
features: Low-power marrow particles composed of abundant fat vacuoles and stromal meshwork
Spindle-shaped stromal cells and fibrillary strands radiating from the particle
Scattered histiocytes and small dark cells without organized hematopoietic islands
Markedly reduced hematopoietic precursors relative to fat
Low magnification limits identification of individual cell types
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows particles consisting predominantly of adipocytes and a stromal meshwork of spindle cells and fibrillary strands, with scattered histiocytes and only sparse hematopoietic cells. No dense hematopoietic islands or megakaryocytes are appreciated at this magnification. Findings indicate a markedly hypocellular, stroma-predominant marrow; in a post-transplant patient this is consistent with graft failure, and should be correlated with blood counts, trephine cellularity and donor chimerism.

ddx.vs: Aspirate appearance is identical; the distinction is clinical, based on transplant history and chimerism rather than morphology.
Myelofibrosis yields scant, poorly spread aspirates and biopsy shows reticulin/collagen fibrosis with atypical megakaryocytes, rather than fat-rich particles.
Relapse shows blasts and recipient chimerism, which are not evident in this field.
